The Lady of the Lake is a kobyss, disguised as a kobold, located in a cave below Campalot in the Ringing Deeps. The cave is reached through the Damp Passage Downwards, and can be left through the Damp Passage Upwards. The remains of two Questing Knights as well as an Unfortunate Goblin can be found nearby, with one of the knights serving as a meal for the "lady".

The Lamplighters are Hallowfall Arathi combatants who wield the Sacred Flame and are responsible for charging into darkness, keeping the dawntowers of Hallowfall lit with the Sacred Flame in defense against Beledar's Shadow, safeguarding Arathi civilians, and rescuing those who are lost. Their creed can be jocularly summarized as "defend the weak, help the troubled, and don't die", and includes helping anyone who needs it, no matter who they are. To fulfill their duty of keeping all of the dawntowers ablaze, Lamplighters travel around Hallowfall on regular patrols, or "Lamplighting routes". They frequently have strong disagreements with the Arathi Army but are free to do as they believe they

Lamplighter Rathling is an Arathi lamplighter encountered in the Earthcrawl Mines. Her squad was following nerubians through a series of tunnels and ended up in the mines. Unfortunately, only she made it out. The rest of the lampilighters were captured by the nerubians. That is until Brann Bronzebeard and adventurers came to her rescue, helped Rathling free the other lamplighters and defeated the nerubians in the mines.

Throughout the dungeon, Al'dalil and the adventurers are gathering said signatures to gain entry -- as it is the only way to reach the Opulent Nexus and stop So'leah. After having gathered the various signatures required to enter the area, the group attempts to stop So'leah only for them to head through various portals. , a lashroom in Hallowfall]] Lashrooms are a race of mushroom creatures found in Khaz Algar. They are typically violent and carnivorous. They can submerge themselves into the ground and are often located in places that fungarians inhabit as well, infesting those areas together. They use their alluring mushroom cap colors to attract both sentient and bestial victims. Lashrooms choke the life out of crops and farmhands alike, making them quite a problem for the Hallowfall Arathi, who frequently have to deal with these creatures.Cutting Edge (quest) Their caps make for good sponges for the earthen.

Lead Foreman Krome is a goblin located at the Venture Plaza in the Undermine. He is one of the big bosses who organizes how Venture's workforce gets split up. In order to enter Kaja'Coast, Grimla Fizzlecrank asked adventurers to kill Krome and take his punch-card.

The Lavaean Hydra is a hydra located at the Brimstone Garrison south of Aberrus in Zaralek Cavern. Its body is never seen; only its heads, which resemble magma serpents, ever surface from the lava. The heads will eat any mob brought near them.
